comments.text: A country of unbelievable contradictions: Worshiping a little girl as a flawless Living Goddess (Kumari), yet in some regions, forcing women into dangerous, isolated huts during their periods (Chhaupadi). Faith in Nepal is both breathtakingly beautiful and terrifyingly dark. What are your thoughts on a child being stripped of her childhood to be a deity, only to have to relearn how to be a normal human after puberty? ✨⛺
